prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Image 1 is the EDIT TARGET for a Dreamerie spot-the-difference puzzle. Return ONE altered image with the EXACT SAME 4:5 framing, geometry, textured painted style and positions. Make exactly the five specified meaningful object edits below. Match this existing illustrator's brushwork, shading and palette. NO random new props, circular patches, tint spots, labels, arrows or answer markers. Keep absolutely everything else unchanged, including background, all edges, decorations and lighting. Do not redraw or reframe the scene. Coordinates are percentages from top-left and help identify objects, not visible boxes.
1. Repaint only the tied ribbon bow across the upper left shoe blue, preserving the long trailing loose laces on the floor pink. Target near x38%, y60%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
2. Edit only this object so: The sun painted on the left toe became a crescent. Target near x36%, y67%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
3. Edit only this object so: The sun in the upper-right landscape became a crescent. Target near x83%, y13%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
4. Edit only this object so: The little chair lost its middle vertical backrest slat. Target near x11%, y45%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
5. Edit only this object so: The lone falling petal to the right of the trunk disappeared. Target near x64%, y38%. Keep all other pixels/objects untouched.
review: Visually reviewed. Only the five declared object regions are composited over the original; labels describe actual generated changes. See edits for final accepted answers.

edits.label: The left shoe’s tied pink bow turned blue.
The sun painted on the left toe became a crescent.
The sun in the upper-right landscape became a crescent.
The little chair lost its middle vertical backrest slat.
The lone falling petal to the right of the trunk disappeared.
